The main takeaway from our work is that
the osmoreceptor mechanism in supraoptic neurons depends on stretch-activated channels, but not on gadolinium-sensitive cation permeability.
gadolinium is not a selective blocker of stretch-activated channels and that its effects are not specific to mechanical gating.
stretch-inactivated ion channels are not just mechanically sensitive, but are also osmotically sensitive.
